description: This file contains metadata, configuration, and build instructions for the PostgreSQL package in a Yocto/BitBake build environment. It defines package dependencies, source URIs, build options, systemd service setup, and included files.

methods.name: pkg_postinst
methods.description: Post-installation script to mask the PostgreSQL systemd service if systemd or sysvinit is used.

methods.name: populate_packages
methods.description: Function to prepend package names based on enabled PACKAGECONFIG options for perl, tcl, and python.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the build environment, applies patches, and sets up Perl library paths.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles the contrib modules of PostgreSQL.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs PostgreSQL files, including contrib modules, tutorials, documentation, init scripts, systemd units, and configuration files.
